integrity.claim_scope: Quenched conditional stationary site-time-average distribution in the weak-reset regime, including critical kurtosis.
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone exact finite-size checker included; infinite-domain results derived analytically.

scientific_limitations: The initial opinions are independent fair fixed signs; resetting is independent local Poisson restoration to those signs.
Results apply to nearest-neighbour continuous-time voting on infinite integer lattices; not a fixed-environment Gaussianity claim.
The stationary time-average limit precedes the vanishing-reset-rate limit; simultaneous limits and general graphs are not covered.
The resolvent formula is established prior literature; publication priority of the new dimension-four law has not been independently certified.
title: A dimension-four Gaussian boundary for quenched stationary voter time averages
